title: Urbanization summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Ritchie, Roser), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): urban overtook rural around 2007 (>half urban); in 1960 rural was >60%; a finer classification gives ~45% cities, 35% towns, 20% villages. Clean version verified internally consistent (rural>60% -> urban<40%; 45+35+20=100; overtaking = majority) before injecting 3 defects findable from the text's own numbers.
